abstract: Gestational trophoblastic disease is a spectrum of disorders of varying malignant potential arising from trophoblastic cells and encompassing hydatidiform moles and persistent trophoblastic neoplasia. Ultrasound is the initial imaging investigation of choice when gestational trophoblastic disease is suspected. Complete hydatiform mole, the most common form of molar pregnancy, usually has a characteristic "cluster of grapes" appearance, especially on second-trimester ultrasounds. Persistent trophobastic neoplasia usually appears as a focal, hypervascular myometrial mass on pelvic ultrasound. Pelvic magnetic resonance imaging is often used as a problem-solving tool in equivocal or complicated cases of gestational trophoblastic disease to assess the degree of invasion into the myometrium and surrounding tissues. Chest x-ray, brain magnetic resonance imaging, and body computed tomography scans are primarily used for the evaluation of metastatic disease, which usually occurs in the context of choriocarcinomas. Choriocarcinoma metastases are usually hypervascular and have a tendency to bleed, features that are reflected in their imaging appearance.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患は、絨毛細胞から生じる悪性度の異なる疾患群であり、胞状奇胎と持続性絨毛性腫瘍を含む。妊娠性絨毛性疾患が疑われる場合、超音波検査が初期画像検査として第一選択である。完全胞状奇胎は最も一般的な胞状妊娠の型であり、特に妊娠中期の超音波検査で典型的な「ぶどうの房」状の所見を呈することが多い。持続性絨毛性腫瘍は、通常、骨盤超音波検査で限局性の高血管性子宮筋層内腫瘤として認められる。骨盤磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は、判定が困難または複雑な症例で、子宮筋層およびその周囲組織への浸潤の程度を評価する問題解決ツールとしてしばしば用いられる。胸部X線、頭部MRI、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は、主に転移性疾患の評価に用いられ、転移は通常絨毛癌に伴って生じる。絨毛癌の転移巣は通常高血管性で出血しやすい傾向があり、その特徴は画像所見にも反映される。
